functions.name: update-version
functions.description: Rename an existing version in place in supported Data Management projects. This operation is not supported for BIM 360 or Forma projects.

name.description: Replacement filename, 1–255 characters, excluding documented reserved characters. Null, omission, and empty cannot clear it.

projectId.description: Data Management project ID; BIM 360 and Forma projects are unsupported by this operation.

versionId.description: Raw version URN to rename; do not URL-encode.

actingUserId.description: Optional user access restriction for a two-legged connection.

FunctionInput_autodesk_updateversion.description: The existing version and its required replacement filename.

id.description: Existing version URN, retained by the rename.

updatedAt.description: Last modification instant in UTC Z with source fractional precision preserved.

versionNumber.description: Version number returned after the rename; no new version is requested.

FunctionOutput_autodesk_updateversion.description: The existing version as returned by the rename, with optional linkage and modification time.

tags.instructions: Use only to change a known version's filename in a supported non-BIM-360/non-Forma project. Obtain its raw URN with `get-version`. This changes the existing version, rather than creating another version or replacing its bytes. For BIM 360 or Forma, use `create-version` with the desired new name instead. No other version properties are editable through this tool. It cannot clear the name.
